scope: User-requested background demo-readiness fix and full retest, plus administrator email or private-link invitations.
changes: Disable viewport/hover prefetch for workspace navigation, family cards, PDF links and matched resource details; protected reads occur on deliberate navigation.
Share the verified Supabase client and active password-session check within one server render, without sharing identities or authorization across requests.
Administrator Settings invitations use the signed-in caller and an independently authorized Supabase Edge Function; privileged credentials remain outside Next.js.

Pending case-manager invitations support native email delivery or a canonical one-use fragment link. Existing confirmed accounts never expose recovery links; inactive accounts and administrator roles are guarded.
Use the school timezone and fixed locale for saved case timestamps so server and browser hydration agree.
Remove trailing PDF step padding that could create an empty continuation page; retain every source field and print margin.
Family profile loads only its editable fields and related counts in one RLS-protected request, rather than seven full-workspace requests.
Profile saves revalidate the actual affected workspace paths without a redundant client refresh. Session failures are recoverable and lost responses preserve entered fields.
All detailed workspace reads embed scoped family relations and bounded histories in one request, followed by the unchanged plan snapshot; the redundant intake refresh is removed.

review.normal: Traced live caller authentication, role checks, provisioning order, audit, confirmed/offboarded users, canonical links, client recovery, account switching, and request-scoped caching. Existing casework RLS and password-session controls retained.
review.ponytail: Separate deletion/reuse pass: native Link prefetch control, React request cache, existing Auth mail templates and operator RPC; no new dependency, schema, abstraction or configurable role picker. Removed a redundant prefetch prop on an in-page anchor and obsolete TOTP advice.
review.embeddedReadsNormal: Reviewed every getFamilyDetail caller, preserved field selection and relation ordering, retained both 50-row history limits, existing snapshot semantics, archived/missing behavior, error propagation, per-table RLS and live-password account checks. The native join uses declared foreign keys and no privileged application client.
review.embeddedReadsPonytail: Separate deletion pass replaces six network reads with native embedded relations and deletes the redundant intake refresh. No new abstraction, retry policy, schema, dependency or timeout increase. The existing plan snapshot remains unchanged.

latestProfileFinding.route: Family profile after saved context and reload
latestProfileFinding.failure: Fifteen-second upstream read timeouts occurred on the POST revalidation and two simultaneous profile GETs. The profile loaded the full plan/directory graph, although it only used editable family fields and counts.
latestProfileFinding.fix: One lean RLS-scoped profile read; explicit current-page revalidation; remove redundant router.refresh; preserve form fields on response loss.

postPromotionEmptyFamilyFailure.fix: Use native RLS-protected embedded relations plus the existing plan snapshot (two requests total); remove the intake client refresh.
